params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). Two identical dark desks standing side by side in one dark room, split down the middle of the frame: on the left desk a closed delivery box ready to hand over, on the right desk the same box opened with warm yellow light glowing from inside. Single warm key light, deep coffee-brown shadows, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, thin haze, subtle golden dust. The upper 40% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm mood.
